evidence.finding: The work before timing generates coordinates, broadcasts them, and executes an initial barrier; it computes no clustering distances or neighbor information.
qtClustering begins with the world/shared communicator split, before CUDA setup or algorithmic preprocessing. The supplied pinned implementation facts establish its world-allreduce start gate.
countNeighbors performs the earliest pairwise distance and threshold computations, producing per-seed neighbor counts.
Inside qtClustering, the count kernel and blocking result copy precede CPU CSR-offset computation, input-dependent scratch planning, and fillNeighbors construction of the neighbor table.
Candidate growth selects eligible points and evaluates further Euclidean distances while updating cached maximum distances.
The joined OpenMP reduction computes the local winner, and MPI_Allreduce selects the global winner inside the clustering call. Its unsigned-long-long buffer matches MPI_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG.

Winner reconstruction completes through a blocking device-to-host copy; membership broadcast, joined host updates, and GPU marking remain inside the call. Every rank executes cudaDeviceSynchronize before returning.
The timer encloses qtClustering and the final world barrier. Non-root ranks return after timing, and root prints the resulting integer-millisecond duration under the canonical label.
